cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

mechanism: A corrects an inventor's service design by committing to increasingly impossible restaurant equipment justified by diner convenience.
confusable: D148 asks approval of A's plan; D163 responds to B's strange offers with a more committed version each time.
comparison: Restaurant service standards differ from a wedding accommodating roaming impossible guests.
seedUse: Keep circling table, airborne waiter and soup orientation; make corrections directly target B's offered capabilities.
